title: fix(billing): round pollen balance mutations to ledger precision
author: aikhusus2025-ctrl
pr_body_excerpt:
## Problem

`shared/billing/precision.ts` documents the ledger policy: *"Ledger debits, credits, and analytics totals round to this precision so they agree exactly"* (1e-8). But the balance mutations never round:

- `claimReward` — `shared/billing/rewards.ts`
- `atomicDeductUserBalance` / `atomicCreditUserBalance` / `atomicDeductApiKeyBalance` — `shared/billing/deduction.ts`

Each does raw float64 `COALESCE(balance, 0) +/− amount` in SQL, so a balance accumulates binary floating-point artifacts. **Live example:** `GET /api/account/balance` currently returns `1.7200000000000013` instead of `1.72`.

## Repro (real SQLite)

Claim the quest lineup `[0.25, 0.25, 0.25, 7, 10]` (= 17.75), then charge 16.03:

| | balance |
|---|---|
| current code | `1.7199999999999989` |
| with this PR | `1.72` |

Every input amount is already 8-decimal-clean (they pass through `roundPollenLedgerAmount` / `assertRewardAmount`); the drift is purely the balance arithmetic itself.

## Fix

Wrap every balance mutation in `ROUND(..., POLLEN_BILLING_PRECISION)` so the stored value stays at ledger precision and comparisons (`>= amount`, bucket decisions) read clean balances:

- `shared/billing/deduction.ts` — tier/pack deduction ladder, API-key budget deduction, credit
- `shared/billing/rewards.ts` — quest reward claim credit

## Test

New `enter.pollinations.ai/test/integration/ledger-precision.test.ts`: seeds a user, claims the real quest lineup, deducts a realistic 16.03 charge, and asserts `tierBalance === 1.72` exactly.

- Fails on `main` (`1.7199999999999989`)
- Passes with this PR

gist.headline: Balances, pruned to eight decimals
gist.blurb: The billing garden was growing a few microscopic float weeds. Every Pollen credit and deduction now gets trimmed to the ledger’s eight-decimal precision, so 1.72 remains pleasantly, unambiguously 1.72.
gist.summary: Rounded all Pollen balance mutations for reward claims, user deductions and credits, API-key deductions, and Stripe billing flows to the ledger’s 1e-8 precision.
gist.impact: Account balances and billing comparisons now retain clean exact-looking values after sequences such as claiming 17.75 Pollen and charging 16.03, yielding 1.72 instead of float residue like 1.7199999999999989.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Polli as a careful garden keeper pruning tiny stray decimal sprouts from a glowing Pollen ledger, while a retro terminal cleanly displays “1.72”. The visual metaphor is precise accounting as tending a healthy garden: rounded coins or pollen grains settle neatly into labeled jars, with code-plants and flowers nearby.
